info.name: Gazebo - Stock Goods Out Without Plan
info.description:
Phase 2 Tab B — Goods Out without a planning requirement.

**Flow:** warehouse product list → scan bag → FIFO/trace → dest auto from `product.destination_container` → `POST /stock/transfer/` queue (omit `requirement_ids` and optionally omit `to_location_id`) → print/verify/post.

**Tables:** `stock_entry` transfer pair + `stock_entry_posting` / label (same as With plan).

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}`, `{{location_id}}`, `{{code}}`, `{{lot_id}}`, `{{entry_id}}`, `{{quantity}}`

request.description:
### Warehouse remaining (product list)

`GET /stock/warehouse/remaining/?location_id=`

Product list for Goods Out without plan browse. Same remaining API as the warehouse home screen.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `location_id` | no | One warehouse; omit for all storage units |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message, data: [ { location_id, location_name, products: [ { product_id, product_name, remaining_qty, … } ] } ] }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |

item.name: Scan bag for Goods Out (FIFO + auto dest)

request.description:
### Scan bag for Goods Out

`GET /stock/scan/goods-out/`

Scan-first popup for Without plan. Returns bag qty, FIFO/trace check (`fifo_ok`, `recommended_trace`), and **auto destination** from `product.destination_container` (`to_location_id`, `dest_ok`).

Main floor control = **trace / FIFO**. Dest is not picked by the user.

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `code` | yes | `E{id}` bag / sticker code |
| `location_id` | yes | Source warehouse |
| `expected_product_id` | no | Lock product when browsing from list |

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`{ status, message, data: { product: { product_id, name, destination_container_id, destination_container_name }, lot_id, trace_number, quantity, fifo_ok, recommended_trace?, to_location_id, to_location_name, dest_ok, dest_message? } }`

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Scan ok (check `fifo_ok` / `dest_ok`) |
| 400 | Bad/incomplete code |
| 409 | No stock here / wrong product |

### Queue Goods Out without plan

`POST /stock/transfer/`

Same queue/print path as With plan, but **omit** `requirement_ids` and **omit** `to_location_id` so the server uses `product.destination_container`. Sets `source_document_type=goods_out_adhoc`.

If scanned lot is not FIFO oldest, send `fifo_override_reason` (same as classic Goods Out).

**Path parameters**

None.

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | yes | Unique key |
| `lot_id` | yes | From scan |
| `from_location_id` | yes | App warehouse |
| `to_location_id` | no | Omit → product dest |
| `quantity` | yes | Default full bag from scan |
| `queue_stock` | yes | `true` for print→verify |
| `source_entry_id` | no | Sticker draw-down |
| `requirement_ids` | no | **Omit** for without plan |
| `fifo_override_reason` | if not oldest | Audit reason |

**Response body**

`{ status, message, data: { out, in, posting, label, goods_out_label } }` — print from `goods_out_label`, then verify/post like Tab A.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 201 | Queued |
| 400 | Missing dest on product, FIFO override required, qty too high |
